datasets.name: 65fc992a
queryLines:
with content as (
  select distinct
      databricks_query_history_id as origin_id
    , concat_ws('_', dashboard_lakeview_source_id, dashboard_source_id, notebook_id, alert_source_id, genie_space_id) as content_id
    , databricks_user_id
    , query_start_time_at - interval 3 hour as query_start_at
    , case
        when cc.source is not null then cc.source
        when dashboard_lakeview_source_id is not null then 'Dashboard - Lakeview'
        when dashboard_source_id is not null then 'Dashboard - Legacy'
        when notebook_id is not null then 'Notebook'
        when alert_source_id is not null then 'Alertas'
        when genie_space_id is not null then 'Genie'
        when databricks_user_id = '435801034309180' then 'Metaservice'
        else 'Demais'
      end as source
    , case
        when dashboard_lakeview_source_id is not null then 'https://picpay-principal.cloud.databricks.com/dashboardsv3/'|| dashboard_lakeview_source_id || '/published'
        when dashboard_source_id is not null then 'https://picpay-principal.cloud.databricks.com/sql/dashboards/' || dashboard_source_id
        when notebook_id is not null then 'https://picpay-principal.cloud.databricks.com/editor/notebooks/' || notebook_id
        when alert_source_id is not null then 'https://picpay-principal.cloud.databricks.com/sql/alerts/' || alert_source_id
        when genie_space_id is not null then 'https://picpay-principal.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/' || genie_space_id
        else ''
      end as link_databricks
    , cc.content_name
  from platform_management.databricks_query_history as qh
  inner join delta.`s3://picpay-datalake-sandbox/cops/cops_content` as cc
    on   qh.dashboard_lakeview_source_id = content_id
      or qh.dashboard_source_id = content_id
      or qh.notebook_id = content_id
      or qh.alert_source_id = content_id
      or qh.genie_space_id = content_id
  where 1=1
)

, cost_query_history as (
  select distinct
      case when :ref_day = 'Cobrança' then date(q.billing_date) else date(qh.query_start_at) end as ref_day
    , trim(lower(user_email)) as user_email
    , qh.link_databricks as content_url
    , qh.content_name
    , e.cost_center_code
    , nvl(f.business_unit_description, 'Não localizado') as business_unit_description
    , nvl(qh.source, 'Demais') as source
    , sum(q.databricks_dbu_cost) as databricks_dbu_cost
    , sum(q.databricks_cost) as databricks_cost
    , sum(q.aws_cost) as aws_cost
    , sum(q.total_cost) as total_cost
  from picpay.finops.queries_databricks_cost q
  inner join content qh
    using(origin_id)
  left join finops.dim_employees e
    on trim(lower(user_email)) = e.employee_email
  left join finops.dim_cost_center_classifications f
    on e.cost_center_code = f.cost_center_code
  where 1=1
    and date(q.billing_date) >= '2025-01-01' or date(qh.query_start_at) >= '2025-01-01'
  group by all
)

, cost_jobs as (
  select
      case when :ref_day = 'Cobrança' then date(dc.billing_date) else date(jr.execution_date) end as ref_day
    , dc.user_email
    , concat('https://picpay-principal.cloud.databricks.com/jobs/', jr.job_id, '/runs/', jr.number_in_job) as content_url
    , coalesce(replace(jr.dag_id, 'ss_pipeline_self_service_analytics', 'SS'), jr.run_name) as content_name
    , dc.cost_center_code
    , 'Operações PF' as business_unit_description
    , case when notebook_path like '/qa-notebooks%' then concat(cc.source, ' Staging') else cc.source end as source
    , sum(dc.databricks_dbu_cost) as databricks_dbu_cost
    , sum(dc.databricks_cost) as databricks_cost
    , sum(dc.aws_cost) as aws_cost
    , sum(dc.total_cost) as total_cost
  from platform_management.databricks_job_runs jr
  inner join (
    select * from finops.job_clusters_databricks_cost
    qualify row_number() over (partition by cluster_id order by billing_date desc) = 1
    ) as dc
    using (cluster_id)
  inner join (select * from delta.`s3://picpay-datalake-sandbox/cops/cops_content` where source in ('DAG', 'Monitoria') )as cc
    on jr.dag_id = cc.content_id or jr.job_id = cc.content_id
  where 1=1
    and jr.execution_date >= '2025-01-01'
  group by all
)

, cost_notebook_interactive as (
  select
    case when :ref_day = 'Cobrança' then date(ic.billing_date) else date(ic.execution_command_at) end as ref_day
  , user_email
  , 'https://picpay-principal.cloud.databricks.com/editor/notebooks/' || notebook_id as content_url
  , cc.content_name
  , cost_center_code
  , 'Operações PF' as business_unit_description
  , cc.source
  , sum(ic.databricks_dbu_cost) as databricks_dbu_cost
  , sum(ic.databricks_cost) as databricks_cost
  , sum(ic.aws_cost) as aws_cost
  , sum(ic.total_cost) as total_cost
  from finops.interactive_clusters_databricks_cost as ic
  inner join (select * from delta.`s3://picpay-datalake-sandbox/cops/cops_content` where source like some ('Monitoria%', 'Notebook%') )as cc
    on ic.notebook_id = cc.content_id
  where 1=1
  and date(ic.execution_command_at) >= '2025-01-01'
  group by all
)

, all_content as (
  select * from cost_notebook_interactive
  union all
  select * from cost_query_history
  union all
  select * from cost_jobs
 ) 
 
 select * from all_content order by ref_day desc

datasets.name: 057e2c90
queryLines:
with usage_qh as (
  select
      date(query_start_time_at - interval 3 hour) as ref_day
    , case
        when cc.source is not null then cc.source
        when dashboard_lakeview_source_id is not null then 'Dashboard - Lakeview'
        when dashboard_source_id is not null then 'Dashboard - Legacy'
        when notebook_id is not null then 'Notebook'
        when alert_source_id is not null then 'Alertas'
        when genie_space_id is not null then 'Genie'
        when databricks_user_id = '435801034309180' then 'Metaservice'
        else 'Demais'
      end as source
    , cc.content_name
    , trim(lower(qc.user_email)) as user_email
    , nvl(cct.business_unit_description, 'Não localizado') as business_unit_description
    , count(distinct query_start_time_at) as total_executions
    , count(databricks_query_history_id) as total_elements_executed
  from platform_management.databricks_query_history as qh
  inner join delta.`s3://picpay-datalake-sandbox/cops/cops_content` as cc
    on   qh.dashboard_lakeview_source_id = content_id
      or qh.dashboard_source_id = content_id
      or qh.notebook_id = content_id
      or qh.alert_source_id = content_id
      or qh.genie_space_id = content_id
      
  inner join (
    select distinct origin_id, user_email
    from finops.queries_databricks_cost
  ) as qc
    on qh.databricks_query_history_id = qc.origin_id
  left join finops.dim_employees as emp
    on trim(lower(qc.user_email)) = emp.employee_email
  left join finops.dim_cost_center_classifications as cct
    on emp.cost_center_code = cct.cost_center_code
  where 1=1
    and query_text not like 'DESCRIBE QUERY%'
    and date(qh.query_start_time_at) >= '2025-01-01'
  group by all
)

, usage_jobs as (
  select
      date(jr.execution_date) as ref_day
    , case when notebook_path like '/qa-notebooks%' then concat(cc.source, ' Staging') else cc.source end as source
    , coalesce(replace(jr.dag_id, 'ss_pipeline_self_service_analytics', 'SS'), jr.run_name) as content_name
    , dc.user_email
    , 'Operações PF' as business_unit_description
    , count(distinct jr.job_id) as total_executions
    , count(distinct jr.job_id) as total_elements_executed
  from platform_management.databricks_job_runs jr
  inner join (
    select * from finops.job_clusters_databricks_cost
    qualify row_number() over (partition by cluster_id order by billing_date desc) = 1
    ) as dc
    using (cluster_id)
  inner join (select * from delta.`s3://picpay-datalake-sandbox/cops/cops_content` where source in ('DAG', 'Monitoria') )as cc
    on jr.dag_id = cc.content_id or jr.job_id = cc.content_id
  where 1=1
    and jr.execution_date >= '2025-01-01'
  group by all
)

, usage_notebook_interactive as (
  select
      date(nb.executed_at) as ref_day
    , cc.source as source
    , cc.content_name
    , ic.user_email
    , nvl(cct.business_unit_description, 'Não localizado') as business_unit_description
    , count(distinct nb.databricks_notebook_command_execution_id) as total_executions
    , count(distinct nb.databricks_notebook_command_execution_id) as total_elements_executed
  from data_governance.databricks_notebooks_commands_executions as nb
  inner join
    (select * from delta.`s3://picpay-datalake-sandbox/cops/cops_content` where source like some ('Notebook%', 'Monitoria%')) as cc
    on nb.notebook_id = cc.content_id
  inner join (
    select
      origin_id, user_email, notebook_id, command_id, execution_command_at from finops.interactive_clusters_databricks_cost
  ) as ic
    -- on nb.databricks_notebook_command_execution_id = ic.origin_id and nb.notebook_id = ic.notebook_id
    on nb.command_id = ic.command_id and nb.notebook_id = ic.notebook_id and nb.executed_at = ic.execution_command_at and nb.user_email = sha2(ic.user_email, 256)
  left join finops.dim_employees as emp
    on ic.user_email = emp.employee_email
  left join finops.dim_cost_center_classifications as cct
    on emp.cost_center_code = cct.cost_center_code
  where 1=1
    and date(nb.executed_at) >= '2025-01-01'
  group by all
)

, all_content as (
  select * from usage_qh
  union all
  select * from usage_notebook_interactive
  union all
  select * from usage_jobs order by ref_day desc
)

select * from all_content

)

, content_jobs as (
  select distinct
      case when notebook_path like '/qa-notebooks%' then concat(cc.source, ' Staging') else cc.source end as source
    , concat('https://picpay-principal.cloud.databricks.com/jobs/', jr.job_id, '/runs/', jr.number_in_job) as link_databricks
    , coalesce(replace(jr.dag_id, 'ss_pipeline_self_service_analytics', 'SS'), jr.run_name) as content_name

  qualify row_number() over (partition by coalesce(replace(jr.dag_id, 'ss_pipeline_self_service_analytics', 'SS'), jr.run_name) order by date(jr.execution_date) desc) = 1
)

select * from content_qh
union all
select * from content_jobs
